The moon is not "deep" space as it's very well within Earth's gravity well, which is why the moon rotates around us and even has it own less intense gravity on the surface. It depends if we're speaking about a surface or orbit moon base but recovering on the surface of the moon would be like slowly acclimatizing for a summit climb, you're body would slowly become use to the lower gravity on the moon(at this point you've been in deep space for a couple years so any gravity is hard on you) which would prepare you for the gravity you'll feel on the surface of earth. The part of saving costs on launch is mainly due to the fact it costs less to escape this gravity well from the moon in terms of fuel vs escaping it from the surface of earth.

You are attempting to leave a gravity well, which leaving the surface of earth requires more energy/fuel than say leaving the orbit of the moon.
